name: warden
description: Guards .env and ~/.secrets reads with warden, redacts credentials from tool output, and shows env health and an /env pane — never a value.

redact.title: Redact credentials
redact.description: Remove credential-shaped values from tool output before the model sees them: live (high-confidence live credentials), all, or off (note only).

band.title: Env health band
band.description: Show warden doctor's problems above the prompt.

bandLevel.title: Band severity
bandLevel.description: The lowest severity the band shows.

wardenPath.title: warden binary
wardenPath.description: An explicit path to warden. Empty: PATH, then ~/.local/bin/warden.
